statement: For every integer r >= 2, the full set of indices minimizing the Eberlein eigenvalues of J(4r+2,2r,r) is I(r)={2}. Consequently the least integer r0 >= 2 such that E_r(2) is a smallest adjacency eigenvalue for every r >= r0 is r0=2, and there are no exceptions in the range 2 <= r < r0.
contribution: This gives an exact sharp threshold and complete exception classification for the t=2 specialization of Proposition 12 of Luo--Cao--Li--Li, which states only that E_r(2) is smallest for all sufficiently large r. The proof makes the trace estimate effective through an exact decreasing trace ratio and checks the sole residual value r=2 exactly.
